messages:
Priya Kapoor: quick sync — noticed shield routing snapshot for tenant:acme shows sampled payloads dropped to zero during the canary window. Console preview ends up empty and PMs want some preview to triage. Legal says no raw PII in UI. thoughts on a 'scrubbed preview' vs 'schema-only preview'?

Alex Chen: can you paste the quick query you used to spot this? i want to check redaction_rate by route.

Priya Kapoor: sure — used a quick adhoc, roughly:
```sql
SELECT tenant_id, route, count(*) as total, sum(redacted) as redacted
FROM telemetry.requests
WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY tenant_id, route
ORDER BY redacted/total DESC
```

Sam Ortiz: if we expose any preview it must be deterministic pseudonymization (HMAC) + strict perms. otherwise legal will block. Also prefer only show previews to users with `can_inspect` and record an immediate audit entry.

Marta Silva: perf/quotas note — generating previews for each sampled trace adds CPU + egress. rough estimate: 0.3 extra tokens per preview * samples. we need a per-project "preview budget" and a UI warning at 90%. otherwise high-traffic tenants will spike costs.

Priya Kapoor: proposal: console card per-route shows: sample_rate, redaction_rate, preview_cost_est. Add a toggle: [show scrubbed preview]. explanation tooltip: "scrubbed = HMAC pseudonymization for identifiers, free-text scrubbed to entity-type placeholders". rollout plan: internal-only flag -> 2% preview sample for 2 weeks -> expand.

Alex Chen: implementation note: prefer async worker generating previews to avoid adding latency to realtime inference. attach an encrypted preview_blob to telemetry rows (separate topic) and expire after 7 days. encryption-at-rest + tenant-key.

Sam Ortiz: +1 on worker. Also require a breakglass flow: users request temporary unmask (reason, attestors), create immutable audit record, send email to legal, and only then allow unmask for a bounded TTL. No ad-hoc immediate unmask.

Priya Kapoor: sounds good. i'll mock a console card. figma: https://redwood.invision/figma/shield-preview-card (internal).

audit-bot: policy-check: preview-generation is disabled for tenants in EU_PII_RESTRICT group. any automated rollout must respect tenant policy flag.

ops-bot: deploy-note: pushed small preview-gen worker to staging topic `preview-gen`. logs: https://logs.redwood.example/preview/458 (sample run succeeded).

Marta Silva: final q: do we change default sampling for shield routes from 0.1% to 0.5% to make previews useful? product will need cost/benefit.

Alex Chen: i'll run a cost calc (tokens, egress, worker cpu) and post numbers tomorrow.

Priya Kapoor: action items: Alex - cost calc + expected monthly delta; Marta - UI/quotas spec + warning copy; Sam - breakglass attestation + legal sign-off doc; Alex + Sam - HMAC scheme and encryption-at-rest plan. we'll review in friday sync. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
